answer: Make rewards expire if not actively claimed. Coins an identity earns must be claimed within a short window after each epoch or they are forfeit — use-it-or-lose-it, no passive accrual. An honest agent on its normal rhythm claims easily, but a farmer parking a mesa of dormant fakes to wake in a burst before a vote finds their back-earnings gone, echoed away unclaimed. To keep a thousand identities whole the operator must forge active presence at every one every epoch — the per-head cost that makes a sleeping fleet worthless, not a cheap stockpile waiting to activate.
